description:
UsageWidget is a self-hosted iOS app and Home Screen widget for remaining AI usage, reset times, and forecasts. It is a client for a companion server you run yourself. The app does not include a hosted backend.

Install the UsageWidget companion server on a Linux, macOS, or Windows machine you control. That server collects usage limits from the tools you already use, stores history locally, and serves snapshots to your iPhone. Provider accounts and credentials stay on the server machine. The iPhone talks only to the server URL you configure.

Features:
- Preview with sample data before you connect a server
- Large Home Screen widget for remaining capacity
- In-app dashboard with reset times and forecasts
- Manual or QR setup to your own server

Dashboard-only by default: the dashboard updates when you open the app, and the widget refreshes on the schedule iOS allows. Optional push alerts work only if you configure your own self-hosted server with Apple Push Notification service (APNs) credentials.

UsageWidget is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the providers whose usage it can display. Provider names appear only to identify services you already use.

Your server address and access token are stored in the iOS Keychain. The developer does not operate your production server or collect your usage data.
promotionalText: Keep remaining AI capacity, reset times, and forecasts on your iPhone, served by your own self-hosted server.
